character.description: 2D chibi side-view anime game sprite of a Jirai-kei x Ryousangata x Cat-motif girl (黒×ピンクの地雷系美少女, 157cm petite chibi proportions) facing right: black hair with pink gradient tips in long wavy twintails, straight bangs (ぱっつん前髪), large pastel pink ribbon and white cat-shaped hairclip (猫型ヘアクリップ), pink-purple eyes with heart highlights, black oversized Jirai-kei hoodie with pink criss-cross ribbon lacing on sleeves, frilly blouse, black-and-pink plaid pleated mini skirt, black lace knee-high socks, and black platform lace-up boots

idle.action: side-view facing right, subtle idle breathing, gentle twintail hair and ribbon sway, and one soft eye blink while feet stay firmly planted on the ground line

walk.action: side-view facing right, smooth even 6-frame walking cycle in place: clear alternating left-foot and right-foot steps (contact, passing, contact, passing), natural opposite arm swing, keeping head height and body proportions strictly identical across all 6 frames

style: high-quality Japanese 2D anime game chibi sprite (繊細なアニメ塗り, 丁寧な線画), clean uniform lineart, pastel pink accents, strictly consistent head-to-body proportions across every frame
